annotation.title_clean: AB-489 Health care professions: deceptive terms or letters: artificial intelligence. (2025-2026)
annotation.title_en: AB-489 Health care professions: deceptive terms or letters: artificial intelligence (2025-2026)
annotation.summary_en: California AB 489 (Chapter 615, 2025) adds Business and Professions Code sections 4999.8–4999.9. They bar AI or generative AI systems from using terms, letters or phrases in advertising or functionality that suggest the health advice comes from a licensed human professional. Health licensing boards enforce the law, and each prohibited use counts as a separate violation.
key_provisions_or_claims: Defines AI and GenAI by reference to the California Government Code
Makes the existing bans on falsely implying a health care licence enforceable against developers and deployers of AI systems
Bars AI or GenAI from implying that its care, advice or assessments come from a licensed natural person
Gives the relevant health licensing boards jurisdiction, including power to seek injunctions
Treats each use of a prohibited term as a separate violation
